name: Fatal Run (NTSC) -- TIA music player
_about: Fatal Run, on the Atari in-house music engine -- the same one
behind Midnight Mutants and Commando, which share a byte-identical
duration table with this one. Found by audiotrace.py --engine.
CHECKED AGAINST THE MACHINE, with one caveat worth stating. Pitch and
waveform of song 0 voice 0 match a 45-second capture on 487 of 487
frames -- exactly. Including volume the same span scores 85.2%, and that
gap is not an error here: this engine's sustain stage writes no volume,
so a sound effect over the music leaves holes in AUDV. Midnight Mutants,
confirmed long ago, behaves the same against its own capture.

songs._banks: Which bank each song's track pointers resolve against, worked out by trying each and keeping the one where every voice led to real patterns.

waveforms._note: Settled by the capture: the other candidate scores single digits.
